gen-fs-expose-gf-yaldevi: Expose runs compressed and sharp, with almost no gap between lowercase and caps. Yaldevi, with oversized lowercase and an e whose eye opens to the right, loosens things up after that tight heading.
gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-clash-grotesk: Round letters bent like wire give Kohinoor Zerone its look. Clash Grotesk keeps every stroke quietly free of thick-and-thin shifts, friendly and approachable, made for brief bursts of reading.
gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-gf-science-gothic: Round, bent-wire letters give the heading its whole character. Kohinoor Zerone is best at striking, precise display, while Science Gothic does its best work letting each letter land separately.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-abeezee: Wire-cut and proud, Nippo stands its small letters up almost at capital height. ABeeZee brings terminals that finish well away from the stem, neon-glass thickness, and a high mean line.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-anek-devanagari: Cut like wire, Nippo joins curves to stems with no swelling at all. Anek Devanagari sits alongside with distinctly open letter mouths and a tall middle zone, so the two work as one modern unit.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-biryani: Biryani, with a large clear eye on every e, sits under Nippo. Its strokes carry no thick-and-thin shifts and its small counters never clog, so paragraphs of text move along smoothly.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-blinker: Blinker reads openly, its lowercase filling most of the height, beneath Nippo. Lines hold their thickness and the apertures stay easy to see, so a sans-serif block of text keeps moving without snagging.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-carrois-gothic: Nippo stands its small letters almost at capital height, cut like wire, with no hairline-to-stem shift anywhere. Carrois Gothic adds generous openings and a high-set x-height, keeping things modern.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Contemporary and technical, Nippo draws small letters with gentle, monotone line thickness. Carrois Gothic SC gives it a counterweight, with clearly opened curve endings and barely any gap between capital and lowercase height.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-cascadia-code: Small letters standing almost capital-sized give Nippo its proud look. Cascadia Code spaces its wire-like monoline letters far apart, so reading moves in a steady, unobstructed glide around each bend.
